scripts.test:parsers: node -e 'console.log("Testing parsers functionality..."); if (typeof window === "undefined") { global.window = {}; } require("./chrome-extension/parsers.js"); if (window.testRejectionDetection) { window.testRejectionDetection(); } else { console.log("Parsers loaded successfully"); }'
scripts.validate:extension: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("chrome-extension/manifest.json")); console.log("Extension validation:", {name: manifest.name, version: manifest.version, manifest_version: manifest.manifest_version}); console.log("✅ Extension files validated");'
